svg.title: F: numerator and denominator df both matter
svg.desc: PDFs of F with numerator and denominator df pairs 5 and 10, 10 and 5, and 20 and 20, from 0 to 6. F is nonnegative and right-skewed; swapping df changes the law. Tails continue beyond 6.
svg.text: F: numerator and denominator df both matter
